What Is a Virtual Assistant?

A virtual assistant (VA) is a remote worker who provides a variety of services such as customer support, administrative support, marketing support, and more – typically from outside of their client’s country. They are employed by a large variety of businesses, from every industry, as a way to improve productivity of in-house teams.
How To Hire a Virtual Assistant: The Complete 2026 Guide

Unlocking the benefits of hiring a virtual assistant can transform your business. From cutting costs to boosting productivity and enhancing flexibility, a skilled virtual assistant is a game-changer for achieving your goals. Ready to make the leap? If you’ve decided that a virtual assistant is the right solution to elevate your business, it’s time to focus on making your first hire a resounding success. The key? Hiring the right virtual assistant for your needs.

Impact guarantee

We guarantee an impact on your business. Or we'll find someone who will.

Full-time, because it works better.

They're not charging you less. They're giving you less.

After 17+ years, full-time consistently outperforms part-time and shared models — so we built our pricing to make full-time the affordable choice, not the premium one. Competitors package part-time behind unit pricing and hourly blocks so the sticker price looks lower. You're not saving money. You're buying less.

Their model

"80 hours per month"

Half the hours, half the focus. The rest of their week belongs to someone else.

"Hours", "units", or "buckets"

When you're buying capacity measured in hours, units, or buckets, you're getting part-time — not a dedicated person.

"24/7 shared assistant pool"

Shared pools work for one-off tasks. They fall apart when your business needs context, judgment, or someone who actually knows how things run.

"Backup assistant included"

More people cycling through your systems means more handoffs, weaker continuity, and more hands in your data. Backup layers exist because no one truly owns the seat.

Our model

One person. 8 hours a day, 5 days a week. Fully embedded in your business.

Full-time isn't a constraint — it's what makes a virtual team member actually stick: enough hours to learn your systems, enough continuity to compound, and enough focus to take real ownership.

Full-time means full context

A dedicated team member learns your systems, your customers, and your standards. Part-timers start from scratch every session.

Security requires consistency

Shared workers cycle between clients, tools, and data environments. That's a liability. A dedicated hire operates inside your systems and only your systems.

Output compounds over time

A full-time team member gets faster, more accurate, and more autonomous every week. Part-time workers plateau because they never get deep enough.

FAQ

Common questions

What kind of work can a virtual assistant handle?

Our virtual assistants handle everything from administrative tasks, customer service, and bookkeeping to marketing, inside sales, transaction coordination, and more. We match you with talent that fits your specific needs.

How quickly can I get started?

Most clients are matched with their virtual assistant within days. Our onboarding process is designed to get your VA integrated and productive as quickly as possible.

How do you ensure quality and security?

Every virtual assistant goes through criminal, identity, employment, and education verification, plus a dual vetting process. Our operations are SOC 2 certified, and we maintain HIPAA and PCI-DSS compliance for regulated industries.

What if my virtual assistant isn't the right fit?

We stand behind every placement. If things aren't working out, we'll find a replacement at no additional cost. Your dedicated account manager handles the transition so you never lose momentum.

Do you support part time?

We build every placement as full-time and dedicated because, after 17+ years and 8,500+ businesses served, that's the model that consistently produces the best outcomes — better retention, deeper context, and stronger ROI than fractional or shared models. We price it to make full-time genuinely economical, not a premium tier. If you're worried you don't have enough work to fill the seat, most clients who come in thinking that quickly find they have more delegable work than they realized — a short scope conversation almost always uncovers enough to justify a dedicated full-time placement, and you get the focus and consistency of a single owner instead of split attention across half-time blocks.

What's included in the monthly rate?

Everything. Recruiting, vetting, payroll, benefits, HR administration, onboarding support, time tracking, and a dedicated account manager are all built into one flat monthly rate. There are no hidden fees or surprise charges.
